blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Caloocan City Mayor Dale “Along” Malapitan on Monday called on the public to observe cleanliness and order during their visit to their loved ones’ graves ahead of Undas—or All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. Malapitan made his call after leading an inspection at the Tala and Bagbaguin Cemetery as part of the city’s preparations for the upcoming commemoration of Undas.
